Class UDFFillScopeService

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.udffill.UDFFillScopeService
@Service public class UDFFillScopeService extends Object
Determines what a fill run works on — the tenant scope of a field — and computes the outcome of a fill source for one security. Parsed templates are cached per field and fill rule version.

  • Method Details

    • getTenantScope

      public List<Security> getTenantScope(UDFMetadataSecurity field, Integer idTenant)
      Returns the tenant scope of a field: every security in a watchlist of the tenant and every security referenced by a transaction of the tenant, restricted to securities the tenant may access and to the asset classes and financial instruments of the field. Securities that appear only in algorithmic strategies are outside the scope.
      Parameters:
      field - the field, possibly an unsaved draft; only its asset classes and instruments are read
      idTenant - the home tenant of the owner of the field
      Returns:
      the securities, ordered by their ID

    • getYahooSymbols

      public Map<Integer,String> getYahooSymbols()
      Returns the persisted Yahoo symbols, the user-0 values of UDF_SPEC_INTERNAL_YAHOO_SYMBOL_HIDE. A security whose symbol has not been stored yet is absent.
      Returns:
      per security ID its Yahoo symbol

    • computeOutcome

      public UDFFillOutcome computeOutcome(UDFMetadataSecurity field, Security security, String yahooSymbol)
      Computes the outcome of the fill source of a field for one security. Makes no write and opens no transaction.
      Parameters:
      field - the field
      security - the security
      yahooSymbol - the persisted Yahoo symbol of the security, or null
      Returns:
      the outcome for UDFFillWriter
